''See also: [[Yerin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin, also known as Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] or the [[Death]] [[Monarch]] Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]], is a formidable [[sacred artist]] and a prodigy of the [[Path of the Endless Sword]]. A disciple of both a [[Sage]] and an [[Underlord]], she is characterized by her intense combat prowess, straight black hair, and a face marked by thin scars. She utilizes specialized equipment, including silver [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] that function as sword-arms and a white-bladed sword inherited from her master. Her combat style is defined by mastery over [[sword aura]] and the ability to manifest a [[Blood Shadow]], which she can use to bolster her strength. Yerin's journey involves significant personal loss, including the death of her master, and she has faced numerous high-level threats ranging from [[Remnants]] to [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]]. Throughout her development, she has transitioned through various stages of power, eventually achieving the status of a [[Monarch]] through the manifestation of the [[Death Icon]]. Though she has been adopted into the prestigious [[Arelius family]] by [[Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius]], her identity is deeply rooted in her own struggle and her commitment to facing death and danger head-on. She is a central figure who has fought alongside [[Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon]], often acting as a protector or a decisive force in high-stakes battles.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin is a warrior with black hair, red eyes, and skin marked by a network of razor-thin scars. She has been seen wearing tattered black robes, white [[Heaven's Glory]] clothes, and formal layers of black, violet, and silver. Her physical form has included extra limbs made of forged [[silver madra]] that extend from her back and a metallic crimson [[Goldsign]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin possesses a pure and clean spirit, though she is prone to intense rage that often outweighs her fear. She is characterized by extreme stubbornness and a refusal to back down from those who speak to her. Her motivations include protecting her companions and pursuing the goal of becoming an [[Underlady]] or ascending further.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She is the disciple of the [[Sword Sage]] and the apprentice of [[Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius]], who is also her brother. Yerin travels with and protects [[Lindon]], whom she has taught combat principles, and is the mother of [[Akura Mercy]]. She is associated with [[Fisher Gesha]] and has been a student or subordinate to [[Timaias Adama]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin follows the [[Path of the Endless Sword]] and utilizes various techniques such as the [[Flowing Sword]], the [[Rippling Sword Striker]], and the [[Moonlight Bridge]]. She can manifest multiple [[Goldsign arms]] to use her [[sword aura{{!}}sword-aura]] and employs a [[Blood Shadow]], which is a crimson spiritual copy of herself. Additionally, she uses the [[Phoenix Song]] to strip [[Remnants]] of their memories and [[madra]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Disciple of the Sword Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As a disciple of the [[Sword Sage]], Yerin follows the [[Path of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11">''Unsouled'', chapter 11</ref> She is a warrior characterized by blade-straight hair, shredded black robes, and a network of scars stretching from her fingertips to her wrists.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c16">''Unsouled'', chapter 16</ref> Though she was born a [[Ruler]], her boundary is not particularly powerful and requires little energy to operate.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17">''Unsouled'', chapter 17</ref> Yerin believes that a [[sacred artist]] must shed blood when the time is right, and she intends to harvest the [[Remnant]] of her master, who was an expert without peer.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> She has forged a flat shimmer in the air resembling a sword hammered from pure force.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> While flying a rosy cloud toward the [[Ancestor's Tomb]], she utilized her [[Endless Sword]] technique to fight a [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19">''Unsouled'', chapter 19</ref> Yerin possesses a [[steel]] limb on her back that resembles one of the six blades on the [[Remnant of the Sword Sage{{!}}Sword Sage's Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20">''Unsouled'', chapter 20</ref> She carries a [[gold badge]] featuring a simple sword image, which she wears around her neck.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Before reaching the age of ten, Yerin was at the [[Iron stage]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c1">''Soulsmith'', chapter 1</ref> As a legendary [[Gold stage]] [[sacred artist]], she serves as a teacher to [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref> Following the murder of her master, she was noted for being missing from the camp.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2" /> A skilled [[Enforcer]] and [[Lowgold]] practitioner, Yerin was the strongest being in [[Sacred Valley]] by a wide margin.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3">''Soulsmith'', chapter 3</ref> She carries a sheathed white blade and possesses a silver sword-arm on her back.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref> Yerin's physical form includes an [[Iron body]] and a [[steel]] arm, complemented by a belt forged from [[Red madra{{!}}red madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4">''Soulsmith'', chapter 4</ref> While traveling with [[Lindon]], she is recognized as a [[sacred artist]] with an extra limb resulting from her [[Gold]] status.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c5">''Soulsmith'', chapter 5</ref> The disciple of a [[Sage]] possesses a pure and clean spirit and belongs to no clan.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6" /> She wears a blood-[[red rope]] around her waist and can gather [[sword madra]] from the environment.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref> Associated with [[Fisher Gesha]], she was granted guest rooms within the main sect and has spent time hunting [[sacred beasts]] and [[Remnants]] while wearing a black robe provided by the [[Fishers]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11">''Soulsmith'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Yerin, a miner who wears a collar and possesses a bladed arm on her back, drew her white sword against [[Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> While questioning [[Eithan]]'s identity, she protested that [[Lindon]] was not sturdy.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /> A peak [[Jade stage]] practitioner with a flawless foundation, Yerin utilizes [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> Her voice could be heard through the door as she looked at [[Lindon]] with pity, noting that she was only halfway through pushing [[madra channels]] through her entire body.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref> After fighting almost without rest for a full night and most of the following day, she was left by [[Eithan]] to watch over [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" /> As a combatant running with [[Lindon]], Yerin used a twisted seashell [[binding]] to spray water and saw her [[Goldsign]] flash during a [[Remnant]] attack.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref> During the confrontation with [[Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral]], she unleashed a wave of [[sword madra]] against [[Jai Long]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref> Despite being outclassed in power by [[Jai Long]], Yerin demonstrated high skill and possesses a bladed [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref> Having not risen from where she fell, her weightless body drifted on the breeze.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Outer Family Student}} ===

name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5">''Blackflame'', chapter 5</ref> A practitioner of [[cycling]] meditation, she has a silver limb and is a [[Goldsign]] with stable [[madra]].<ref {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Yerin is an eighteen-year-old girl with skin covered in razor-thin scars who wears tattered black robes and carries two silver blades along with a sword buckled to her hip on a red belt.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c1">''Skysworn'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref> Her sharp and cold power is not yet fully formed, though she has achieved [[Highgold]] and possesses a [[Goldsign]] of silver arms that flatten into sword-blades, which may be out of her control.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c1" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2">''Skysworn'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /> A reluctant host to a sealed [[Blood Shadow]] that she wears as a belt, she is a [[sacred artist]] who has earned rewards from the [[Arelius family]] and was once told by [[Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel]] to be sought by [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11">''Skysworn'', chapter 11</ref> While [[cycling]], she seeks the voice of the [[Sword Sage]], and rumors suggest she was once a disciple of a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /> Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] carries a pale sword and wears a [[red rope]] of living [[madra]] around her waist that is rank with [[Blood aura{{!}}blood aura]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /> After helping [[Lindon]] prepare for a duel, she informed him of [[Jai Long]]'s comparison of him to a [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4">''Skysworn'', chapter 4</ref> Though she cannot read, the companion adopted by [[Eithan]] intends to join the [[Skysworn]] and pursue those raising swords against [[Redmoon Hall]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10">''Skysworn'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13">''Skysworn'', chapter 13</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Skysworn application}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|As an emissary of [[Redmoon Hall]], Yerin participated in the [[Highgold]] course and successfully passed the application in first place.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15">''Skysworn'', chapter 15</ref> Her [[madra]] is considered rock-stable for a [[Lowgold]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15" /> After the [[Skysworn]] struggled onto his cloud and flew over to her, a parasite failed to enter Yerin's core.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref> [[Yerin's spirit]] became exhausted from her efforts to prevent the [[Blood Shadow]] from taking control, yet her rage proved stronger than her fear.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17">''Skysworn'', chapter 17</ref> By this time, most of her body was down the stairs.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Yerin]]'s [[madra]] is rock-stable for a [[Lowgold]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|While held in [[chains]] and shackles, Yerin displayed [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] consisting of blades made from [[Forged]] [[silver madra]], which manifested as two blade-ended arms extending from her back.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref> Her [[Blood Shadow]] is a mass of living [[blood madra]] that forms a copy of her.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref> After passing through a [[Jade{{!}}jade]] doorway sword-first, she utilized the [[Rippling Sword Striker]] technique.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4" /> Refusing to leave [[Lindon]] behind, she attempted to reach a [[portal]] to save him.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c5">''Ghostwater'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref> Despite having an empty core, Yerin met with the [[Sage]] and taught [[Lindon]] principles of combat.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref> Following the [[Path of the Endless Sword]], her [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] were folded over her shoulders and her [[madra]] was dense enough to cross the barrier to [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref> Yerin is currently separated from [[Lindon]], who has been apart from her for a long time and mentions her.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref> During a period spent running from [[dragons]] through the woods with [[Mercy]], she used a sword to push herself up while her arms felt a hundred times heavier than usual and the skin on her right arm appeared red-and-black, twisted, and almost melted.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c14">''Ghostwater'', chapter 14</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Skysworn cloudship pilot}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|As a pilot of the [[Skysworn cloudship]], Yerin is a character capable of slashing [[acidic madra]] from the air using three blades.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref> Her silver [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] can be withdrawn into her back, where she can manifest six arms of [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> She utilizes pulses of tightly controlled [[sword madra]] and can [[veil]] her [[madra]], fighting with a style defined by seamless movement.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter name="cradle-06-underlord-c17">''Underlord'', chapter 17</ref> Despite her skill and the fact that [[Lindon]] promised her the remaining [[Spirit Well water]], Yerin's lifeline was severely damaged, leaving her in a dying state.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref> As she was treated by [[Brightcrown]] healers and spoke of survival, it became clear that [[Lindon]] needed to save her so her [[soulfire]] could rebuild her lifeline.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" /> A practitioner of the [[sacred arts]] who possesses [[soulfire]], Yerin's ultimate goal is to become an [[Underlady]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Uncrowned King tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Yerin is a competitor in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament]] who possesses six gleaming sword-arms.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref> She utilizes [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] that sweep like claws and a [[sword aura{{!}}sword-aura]] capable of detonating into the [[Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /> While she uses the [[Shadow]] technique, she is not an [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] by birth, though she was later adopted into the family.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> Lacking sight, she uses a blindfold to focus her perception and can only feel [[madra]] rather than seeing it.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> Her purple crystalline [[construct]] utilizes both dream and [[shadow madra]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> A former [[Highgold]], she is an adopted member of [[Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius]] who communicates with [[Lindon]] via a jewel-[[construct]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6">''Uncrowned'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> During the competition, she took a crown and ranked eleventh.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> As a chosen of [[Akura Malice]] from the [[Blackflame Empire]], she uses her [[sword aura{{!}}sword-aura]] to annihilate large ranks of weaker enemies.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18">''Uncrowned'', chapter 18</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Yerin appears wearing a [[sacred artist's robe]] identical to the one [[Lindon]] previously observed her in.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref> Having advanced to the [[Underlord]] stage, she possesses [[Diamond Veins]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19" /> She feels intense fury toward [[Northstrider]] for forcing her into a confrontation with [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref> During the battle, she utilizes a crimson spiritual copy of herself known as a [[Blood Shadow]] to observe her opponent and fight alongside her.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" /> Although her body trembles with the effort of the struggle, her [[Blood Shadow]] wields a version of the [[Final Sword]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" /> Yerin ultimately emerges victorious in her fight against [[Lindon]], despite the fact that she is frequently mobbed by strangers.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21">''Uncrowned'', chapter 21</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Yerin is the apprentice and subordinate of [[Timaias Adama]], having departed alongside him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1">''Wintersteel'', chapter 1</ref> As a [[Jade]] with a parasite in her soul, she possesses power on the level of an [[Archlord]] and is considered a potential future [[Sage of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1" /> A fighter associated with [[Malice]], she remains active in the competition and utilizes a gem-like [[dream tablets{{!}}dream tablet]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> While accompanying [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], she observed a fight from the [[Akura audience platform]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> Despite a false announcement that she would fight [[Mercy]], Yerin is instead scheduled for a month of training with a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref> Dressed in formal layers of black, violet, and silver, she possesses powers similar to [[Blacksword]] and watches the [[Uncrowned]] matches alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Pupil of the Winter Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Although [[Red Faith]] expressed interest in tutoring her, Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] was instead chosen as a pupil by the [[Winter Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Clad in a standard black uniform, she has cultivated her [[Blood Shadow]] using a technique from the [[Blood Sage]] and experienced nine-colored light swirling around her as she closed her eyes.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /> After gathering with [[Mercy]] and [[Eithan]] at the end of a [[cloudship]] dock, Yerin stayed in a network of wooden huts where her outer robe was shredded by icy winds.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> Despite having an adequate foundation and previous training to sense [[sword aura]] in freezing cold, her [[Forger technique]] remains brittle and weak.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> The heir to the [[Endless Sword]] utilizes [[spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense]] and the [[Hidden Sword]] technique to fight.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> Following a near-fatal encounter with [[Riyusai Meira{{!}}Meira]], Yerin fought a demon in a snowy village while being aware that a [[Monarch-killing weapon]] was at stake.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11">''Wintersteel'', chapter 11</ref> While [[Eithan]] can funnel [[advancement]] resources to her, Yerin hoped he had permission for his actions.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref> During a battle with [[Lindon]], Yerin used her sword and calming breaths to maintain her [[madra]] flow, which caused her sword to glow silver.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref> After her spirits lifted when the [[Ninecloud Soul]] manifested, Yerin sensed her dormant [[Blood Shadow]] and [[sword madra]] before being announced the winner of the tournament by the [[Ninecloud Soul]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|As a potential participant in the tournament, Yerin fell toward [[Lindon]] with her sword raised.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref> While at the [[Frozen Blade school]], she successfully decoded instructions to absorb power into her core and was present during a discussion regarding the final gift.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> After interrupting and insulting the [[Blood Sage]], she witnessed mirror images of her own memories and observed her own serene expression while facing [[Calan Archer]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20">''Wintersteel'', chapter 20</ref> While her core remained full but inactive during the settling of the [[Madra Engine]], she cycled [[sword aura]] amidst a forest of blades.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20" /> Yerin, a user of [[Blood aura{{!}}blood aura]] and a [[Blood Shadow]], demanded that [[Charity]] fetch them while utilizing an [[Enforcer technique]] on her sword blade.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref> She is capable of gathering [[madra]] and aura into her blade to produce silver-white energy.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21" /> Following the moment [[Crusher]] tossed Ruby, Yerin closed the distance with [[Yan Shoumei]] to fight for the safety of [[Lindon]], [[Eithan]], and [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> On her path to becoming a [[Sword Sage]] upon reaching [[Archlord]], she refuses to back down from those speaking to her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22" /> A top two fighter in the tournament and a recent competition winner, she was scheduled to fight [[Yan Shoumei]] but grew wary of how the [[Shadow]] looked at [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> Despite the [[Blood Shadow]] attempting to act against her, Yerin revealed to her Overlord that she is not him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Having previously held the rank of [[Underlord]], Yerin was once decapitated by [[Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25" /> During combat, she utilizes the [[Flowing Sword technique]] empowered by [[soulfire]], [[cycling]] both red and [[silver madra]] into her strikes.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> By employing the [[Moonlight Bridge]] to appear behind [[Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara]] and utilizing the [[Final Sword]], she produced a red-[[white light]] that blasted through the image of the golden dragon, leading [[Dross]] to report her victory.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /> Following her win at the [[Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament]], Yerin may witness [[Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara]] saving [[Akura Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> While watching [[Malice]] fight the [[Dragon King]], Yerin intended to use [[Penance]] and the [[Moonlight Bridge]], but she instead appeared in a white glow and was pinned in place by the Heart and Winter [[Sages]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref> While being held by the [[Sages]], she questioned them and demonstrated her ability to recognize the owner of the second [[cloudship]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Yerin possesses two metallic red sword-arms that feature a crimson tint.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c2">''Bloodline'', chapter 2</ref> Her immense strength has the capability to warp reality, and her powerful perception is supported by a level of power that exists a dimension higher than a normal [[Lord]]'s.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref> Following a merger with Ruby and her [[Blood Shadow]], Yerin's body has partially fused with her spirit.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5">''Bloodline'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref> While present in the scene, she noted that although she was not at her peak, she was not made of glass.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6" /> After traveling via the [[Moonlight Bridge]], she was attacked by five streaks of light.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6" /> The girl who took [[Lindon]] away from [[Sacred Valley]] fought to protect him.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8">''Bloodline'', chapter 8</ref> While sitting with [[Mercy]] and [[Orthos]], [[Lindon]] planned to visit the [[Wei clan]] with her.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref> Her spirit is described as being tangled with her body, and she is a character mentioned by [[Jai Long]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10">''Bloodline'', chapter 10</ref> With red eyes and metallic crimson [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]], Yerin holds [[Lindon]]'s left hand while acting as the one in charge of him and [[Wei Mon Teris{{!}}Teris]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c11">''Bloodline'', chapter 11</ref> Watching the evacuation from [[Lindon]]'s shoulder, she used the [[Moonlight Bridge]] technique and maintained her presence to keep herself from throwing herself at the enemy.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12">''Bloodline'', chapter 12</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Wei clan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|While at the [[Wei clan]], Yerin stood upon the bough of a giant tree.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14">''Bloodline'', chapter 14</ref> She previously escaped pursuers from her school in the wild territory on her own.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> After dropping through a ceiling hatch, she was found to possess the [[Broken Crown]] while her [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] moved erratically.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref> Yerin noted that [[Lindon]] is a person who does not give up and would not abandon her even if her core popped and she became no better than a [[Copper]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16" /> Her eyes have the ability to glow red like [[scripts]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16" /> Because her [[Divine Treasure]] failed to recover in time, Yerin felt useless after losing her spine and briefly experienced having two minds in her head.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> An outsider to [[Lindon]]'s home, she saw herself caught by the tail of the [[Wandering Titan]] in a vision.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /> Yerin dashed out of a blue-edged crack in space to focus the [[Final Sword]] through her blade as the [[Dreadgod]] moved toward her.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> Her body was eventually covered in veins of bright [[Red madra{{!}}red madra]] that replaced her broken flesh.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While questioning the anchor, Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] was expected to drive off the [[Dreadgod]], and her presence could be felt by [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref> After [[Lindon]] brought her to the [[Sword Sage’s void space]], Yerin paused at the entrance of a [[Tomb]] where she had previously fought her master's [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c3">''Reaper'', chapter 3</ref> The [[Uncrowned Queen]] and hero of the [[Blackflame Empire]] spent time playing darts with sharpened blades of grass.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5">''Reaper'', chapter 5</ref> Possessing dream techniques, Yerin is a person of interest to [[Red Faith]] who can be tracked with [[spiritual perception]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref> Yerin hated her [[Phoenix]] and her [[Blood Shadow]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" /> Located in [[Serpent's Grave]], she drew her black sword as [[Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel]] entered.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8">''Reaper'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> Yerin leaped with [[Lindon]] and used a wave of razor-sharp [[madra]] against the [[Tomb Hydra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref> She cycled her last [[elixirs{{!}}elixir]] to focus on a layer of red aura around her.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> Dressed in black robes with a black sword and most of her hair being black, she also had red eyes, [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]], and a single lock of red hair.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> Using the [[Netherclaw]] technique, Yerin was not slowed by tridents but was eventually pinned to a wall and imprisoned by dense [[water madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Nethergate journey}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Yerin emerged from the [[Nethergate]] alongside [[Eithan]] after they had walked up to the [[portal]] together.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24">''Reaper'', chapter 24</ref> Upon their arrival, she questioned [[Lindon]] about recent events and took a seat on his left side.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref> She expressed her frustration toward [[Eithan]] for allowing her to believe they were gaining on him, and she was present when the encounter with the [[Abidan]] occurred.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27">''Reaper'', chapter 27</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Yerin is a person for whom an echo could be created and whom [[Lindon]] intends to call.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref> Appearing in a flash of [[white light]] on the back of a ship at sea, this defective [[Herald]] carries a black blade sword named [[Netherclaw]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> As one of the six beings threatened by the [[Silent King]], she is the subject of a complex [[construct]] being created by [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> While aboard a vessel belonging to [[Redmoon Hall]], the [[Overlady]] intends to strip the organization down to their bones once she learns what she can.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref> An [[Overlord Herald]] who possesses a [[void key]], Yerin's body and spirit exist in closer harmony than any other Overlord.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref> After her parents were killed by [[Blood Shadows]], she learned to use [[blood madra]] to heal herself and developed a [[soulspace]] that allows her to translate the squeaks of [[Riverseed]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14">''Dreadgod'', chapter 14</ref> An apprentice of [[Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius]] and an associate of [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]], she is a [[Riverseed]] capable of fighting [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> Yerin uses a [[hunger spears{{!}}hunger spear]] in combat and is currently pushing for [[advancement]] while collecting [[natural treasures]] from her master's belongings.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|During her battles, Yerin fought alongside the [[Blood Sage]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> She is characterized by her scarlet [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]], a red streak of hair, and the existence of a [[soul-oath{{!}}soul oath]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> While questioning why the [[Dreadgods]] and [[Monarchs]] are pursuing them, she remains a person who intends to ascend one day.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> [[Lindon]] was able to feel her [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Heaven's Glory School}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Yerin waited for [[Lindon]] at the former site of the [[Heaven’s Glory School]], located just outside the [[Ancestor's Tomb{{!}}Ancestor’s Tomb]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> While there, she demonstrated the ability to pluck memories from the air and waited for memory constructs to arrange themselves around her.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> She is capable of vanishing in a flash of light and possesses one [[Archlord]] blade along with six [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref> Yerin eventually arrived at the entrance to the [[Soulforge]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While concerned about [[Mercy]]'s condition, Yerin possesses a [[Heart’s Gem]] and appears beside [[Lindon]] in a flash of [[white light]] with his arm around her.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref> She was the only person besides [[Lindon]] to remain standing during the test, and the two of them are the reasons individuals such as [[Mercy]] or [[Little Blue]] might follow them.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> [[Reigan Shen]] desires the departure of both [[Lindon]] and Yerin, who experienced time dilation relative to one another.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref> Utilizing [[Forged]] [[earth madra]], Yerin achieved a [[Herald]] state ahead of schedule.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref> After sending a message through the [[Dreamway]], she spent time in her [[Ghostwind Hall]] [[cycling]] room gathering [[sword aura]] and blood.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> As a character capable of activating [[The Paths of Heaven{{!}}Paths of Heaven]], Yerin has expressed jealousy toward [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12" /> Known as the [[Uncrowned Queen]], she hovered before the [[cloud fortress]] using her [[Divine Treasure]] [[Moonlight Bridge]] and the [[Phoenix Song]] technique.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Yerin flooded her sword with [[madra]] and pursued [[Lindon]], demonstrating an ability to push through [[advancement]] realms through sheer stubbornness.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /> Shining like a crimson star, she emitted a scarlet fury that outshone the sun while expanding her spirit into the surrounding [[Blood aura{{!}}blood aura]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref> After using her blade to kill [[Yushi]], she escaped by cutting through [[Way{{!}}the Way]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c16">''Waybound'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Yerin possesses the ability to use her [[Phoenix Song]] to strip [[Remnants]] of their [[madra]], memories, and will, though she feels her heart tighten like a bowstring.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /> While traveling toward the battle, she battles through [[lightning-dragons]] and a hostile storm.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> After attempting to activate her [[Moonlight Bridge]], she has already shot off on her own.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> An individual [[Orthos]] has dealt with before, Yerin flies at high speed toward the combat area.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> Feeling arrogant and intending to execute the [[Dreadgod]], she moves toward the [[Weeping Dragon]] like a silver-and-red comet.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> She can float using only her will without manipulating [[Wind aura{{!}}wind aura]], and she utilizes twin [[Remnants]] after stealing power from a [[Herald]] and a [[Sage]] to sustain herself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> As the [[dragons{{!}}Dragon]] focused on her with claws and lightning, Yerin was left covered in bruises, cuts, and burns.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Because her [[madra]] is incompatible with the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s, [[Lindon]] seeks material to create a real sword for her.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> Ozriel had hoped to see her ascend.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref> Wrapped in many bandages, Yerin is one of [[Lindon]]'s flunkies and is mentioned regarding [[Mercy]]'s training.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ghostwind Hall}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While meditating on the eighth [[Path of Heaven]] in [[Ghostwind Hall]], Yerin's eyes blazed red much like [[Fury]]'s.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> She cycled her [[madra]] to its absolute limit in an effort to remain standing under [[Malice]]'s [[Authority{{!}}authority]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /> During combat, her sword blazed with red-and-[[silver madra]] as she utilized a [[Flowing Sword Enforcer technique]] through her [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> Pushing her [[Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body]] to its limits, she employed a [[hunger techniques{{!}}hunger technique]] with the intent of making her opponent a sword artist in five seconds.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /> As the [[Death Icon]] raises her to [[Monarch]], Yerin caught [[Mercy]] and has been working restlessly on [[Eithan]]'s attack.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> Possessing good insight into the [[advancement]] to [[Herald]], she provided support to [[Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss]] while keeping pace with [[Lindon]] as he flew through a gap between the [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref> After [[Reigan Shen]] used her [[Moonlight Bridge]] to redirect her, Yerin utilized [[black-and-white Striker techniques]] that left cuts carrying echoes of death.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> Though her ascension was not as smooth as [[Fury]]'s, she used her [[Goldsign]] to cut a hole in [[Way{{!}}the Way]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> Despite having warned [[Larian]], Yerin was not on the other side of the rift [[Lindon]] opened, leading him to worry she might have been jailed.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref> Yerin wears black armor.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]], who protects the cult of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], possesses a [[Blood Shadow]] capable of forging the claw.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> Tasked with solving problems that can be killed, she is noted as someone who would have ended the [[Fiend]]'s life quickly.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> After being mentioned by [[Dross]], Yerin has advanced to the rank of [[Overlady]] [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> While traveling through [[Way{{!}}the Way]] with [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], she leaned her elbow on [[Lindon]]'s head and envisioned her fragment as a place where life could flourish and spread.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" /> She suggested the name [[Refuge]] for this world before emerging from a [[Way-portal]] alongside [[Lindon]] amidst [[Abidan]] warnings.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref> During a visit to her birthplace, the [[Death]] [[Monarch]] Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] remarked that the town felt like home, despite having lost her original home to [[The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“He was,” Yerin said, her voice distant.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Need to harvest his Remnant,” she said, stretching.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“He's strong,” she said to Lindon, though even she kept her comment to barely above a whisper.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Behind him, Yerin protested. “He's about as sturdy as a newborn kitten.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“I’ll admit that’s been my experience,” Yerin allowed, “but my master used to say that no Path is wide enough for two.”<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20" />}}
